name: Matsu Tamane
concept: Tamane's eyes move to the door the moment someone else enters a room, and she does not look away until she has placed them.

answers.giri: Matsu Kinzo, has tasked Matsu Tamane with holding his militia intact through the winter raids, and she keeps them alive by methods he has forbidden her to use and does not ask about.
answers.ninjo: Tamane wants Agasha Tetsuya to recognize that she sees what he refuses to: that the raiders will not learn the forms, and that holding his men to them costs him soldiers he cannot spare, and she cannot watch him lose another one to a rule that serves his pride more than his militia.
answers.standout_quality: Tamane reads the moment when discipline breaks in another person and moves before they do, which saves lives and infuriates her instructors.
answers.accomplishment: Matsu Tamane held Agasha Tetsuya's border garrison together through two winters of raiders without losing a man to the forms, though she has never told him how.
answers.challenge: The militia in Agasha Tetsuya's borderlands know better than to ask Matsu Tamane for help getting around his orders, but they do it anyway, and she has to choose between the man she serves and the men she cannot watch die for his rules.
answers.peace: Tamane watches a raider's son learn to hold a spear properly from someone who isn't his father, and doesn't mention it to Tetsuya.
answers.fear: When Tamane addresses Agasha Tetsuya's officers in the garrison hall, she feels the weight of their eyes cataloguing which orders she will enforce and which she has already bent, and she cannot tell if they despise her for the bending or for the enforcement.

clan_relationship.text: Matsu Tamane agrees that discipline and kata are the Lion's strength, but she has stopped believing they work on men who were never taught them, and she no longer reports this disagreement up the chain.

mentor.name: Hida Yoshikado
mentor.text: Hida Yoshikado taught her that a man can believe in kata until his garrison starves, and that watching him believe it costs more than breaking the rules to stop him.

answers.first_impression: Tamane's eyes move to the door the moment someone else enters a room, and she does not look away until she has placed them.
answers.stress_reaction: Tamane stops listening to what people say and starts answering what they haven't, which means the officers in the garrison never know whether she's heard them or read them, and neither do they.
answers.relationships:
Doji Utamuro (Crane) — Doji Utamuro came to the borderlands as a trade negotiator and saw immediately that Agasha Tetsuya's rigid insistence on kata made him a poor ally; Tamane has spent three years making sure Utamuro never needs to say so to his superiors, which means she tells him things she does not tell Tetsuya, and now owes a Crane courtier more honesty than she owes the Dragon lord she actually serves.
Shinjo Yori (Unicorn) — Shinjo Yori rode into the garrison one autumn with a merchant caravan and asked Tamane, in front of the officers, whether Agasha Tetsuya's men were disciplined or just afraid; Tamane answered him honestly instead of defending her lord, and Yori has since sent word twice asking her to ride west and see how the Unicorn actually train their border scouts, which she cannot do without admitting to Tetsuya that she finds his methods lacking.

parent_opinion.description: Tamane's mother says she has never known her daughter to ask for permission, only forgiveness, and that this works until the day it does not.

answers.death: Tamane expects to die in garrison, having finally told Tetsuya what he refused to hear, and having lost the men she kept alive by keeping silent.

peculiarities.name: Despised in Kyuden Kakita
peculiarities.subject: Kyuden Kakita
peculiarities.text: You are infamous among the residents of a particular city (chosen with the GM). People within this city resist cooperating with you and may actively hinder your activities within the city. When performing a check to gain assistance or cooperation from a resident of the city that despises you (such as a Courtesy [Water] check to learn the latest sake house rumors or a Commerce [Water] check to purchase goods within the city), you must choose and reroll two dice showing (op) or (st) results. After resolving the check, if you failed, you regain 1 Void point.
